risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical or electrical faults, such as a faulty motor, pump, or control board.
risks.proof: A close-up video of the machine running through a full cycle, including water filling, spin, and drainage.

risks.risk: The machine may have been repaired or modified, which could affect its performance or warranty status.

Close-up video of the drum rotating during a spin cycle.
Photo or video showing the internal components or repair history if applicable.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
